name: claudeguard-integrity
description: ClaudeGuard Integrity — a deterministic integrity gate over already-merged code. Sibling of ClaudeGuard, which judges a diff before merge; this one checks the whole tree after it, with no model in the decision path.

plugins.name: claudeguard-integrity
plugins.description: Deterministic integrity gate over already-merged code — AST purity closures, file invariants and a byte-level source-encoding scan.
